jobs.description:
SFEIR est un cabinet d'expertise technologique spécialisé dans la conception, l'architecture et l'industrialisation de solutions numériques sur-mesure. Nous accompagnons les organisations dans leurs transformations les plus complexes en combinant la rigueur du Software Craftsmanship avec la maîtrise des technologies d'avenir. Convaincus que la souveraineté numérique est un enjeu stratégique majeur, nous concevons des architectures sécurisées, performantes et indépendantes, portées par des partenariats solides avec des acteurs clés comme SENS et Scaleway. Acteur de référence sur l'intelligence artificielle, nous faisons évoluer les standards d'ingénierie modernes. À travers notre plateforme GenAI RAISE et notre statut de partenaire Anthropic Select (au sein du Claude Partner Network), nous plaçons le Context Engineering et l'IA générative au cœur de nos pratiques. 

Nos chiffres clés :

  • 950 consultants passionnés par la tech et augmentés par l’IA
  • 8 agences en France, au Luxembourg et en Belgique
  • Partenaire Anthropic Select au sein du Claude Partner Network
  • 15 ans de partenariat avec Google Cloud, AWS, Microsoft, Databricks, Confluent...
  • +5000 personnes formées par an via le SFEIR Institute

Rejoindre SFEIR, c'est intégrer un collectif où la culture technique prévaut. Nous offrons des trajectoires de carrière dédiées aux experts (Individual Contributor / IC), te permettant de progresser en haute maîtrise technique sans devoir basculer vers du management organisationnel. Nous intégrons l'IA à nos propres pratiques d'ingénierie (utilisation quotidienne de RAISE et Claude Code) pour automatiser les tâches à faible valeur ajoutée et concentrer nos efforts sur la conception d'architectures résilientes.

▪️ À propos de la mission

Pour accompagner la forte croissance de notre collectif Sud-Ouest, nous recherchons notre futur Développeur .Net/C# (F/H/NB).

Tes missions au quotidien :

  • Back-end : Maîtrise avancée de C# / .NET 8+, architectures Microservices et APIs sécurisées
  • Data & Messaging : Gestion de la donnée sous toutes ses formes avec SQL Server, MongoDB et architectures orientées événements via Kafka
  • Cloud & Industrialisation : Déploiement sur environnements Cloud Public (Azure, AWS ou GCP) et conteneurisation (Docker/Kubernetes)
  • Craftsmanship : Le Clean Code, le TDD et les revues de code sont tes standards de livraison, pas des options

▪️ Le profil idéal

Formation & Parcours : Bac+5 en informatique (école d'ingénieur, Master) ou équivalent.

Expérience : 5 ans minimum comme Développeur .NET (idéalement sur de forts volumes de données), avec une maîtrise de :

  • .NET Core 8, Microservices, DDD, REST & Design First.

  • Databases & Messaging : SQL Server, MongoDB, Kafka, RabbitMQ.

  • DevOps & Cloud : DevOps (CI/CD), Docker, Kubernetes, Grafana.

  • Outillage : Git, JIRA.

Soft Skills : Esprit d'équipe, autonomie, rigueur, sens de l'initiative et curiosité technique.

▪️ L'ancrage Bordelais

L'agence SFEIR Bordeaux regroupe une quinzaine d'ingénieurs et d'architectes seniors. Tu y trouveras la proximité et l'agilité d'une structure à taille humaine, adossée à la solidité d'un grand groupe. Tu participes activement à l'écosystème tech local (meetups, conférences BDX/IO, SFEIR Talks) et tu peux intégrer le programme AI Champions pour piloter la R&D de l'agence.

▪️ Tes conditions de travail 

  • Organisation : 2 à 3 jours de télétravail par semaine.
  • Équipement : Laptop haut de gamme au choix (MacBook Pro ou Dell Precision dernière génération).
  • Package : Rémunération fixe attractive, prime de vacances, accord d'intéressement, forfait mobilités durables, mutuelle et titres-restaurant.

▪️ Le processus de recrutement 

  1. Échange RH : Alignement sur ton parcours, tes attentes et les opportunités SFEIR.
  2. Session Technique ("PlayOffs") : Évaluation pratique en pair-programming (Algo, C# et .Net) avec trois Sfeirians.
  3. Échange Métier & Projection : Discussion approfondie sur les cas d'usage, les missions cibles et le contexte client à Bordeaux.
  4. Entretien Final : Échange stratégique avec le Directeur d'Agence.

Prêt·e à passer au niveau supérieur sans renoncer à tes valeurs ? Postule et viens rencontrer le collectif !

Machines Premium : MacBook Pro ou Dell au choix.

Zenride

Lieu : chez nos clients sur la métropole strasbourgeoise ou dans notre factory

Entretien RH avec Geoffrey ou Selma 

PlayOffs : Tests tech en pair-programming (algo, langage, plateforme) avec 3 Sfeirians

jobs.description:
SFEIR est un cabinet d'expertise technologique spécialisé dans la conception, l'architecture et l'industrialisation de solutions numériques sur-mesure. Nous accompagnons les organisations dans leurs transformations les plus complexes en combinant la rigueur du Software Craftsmanship avec la maîtrise des technologies d'avenir. Convaincus que la souveraineté numérique est un enjeu stratégique majeur, nous concevons des architectures sécurisées, performantes et indépendantes, portées par des partenariats solides avec des acteurs clés comme SENS et Scaleway. Acteur de référence sur l'intelligence artificielle, nous faisons évoluer les standards d'ingénierie modernes. À travers notre plateforme GenAI RAISE et notre statut de partenaire Anthropic Select (au sein du Claude Partner Network), nous plaçons le Context Engineering et l'IA générative au cœur de nos pratiques. 

Nos chiffres clés :

  • 950 consultants passionnés par la tech et augmentés par l’IA
  • 8 agences en France, au Luxembourg et en Belgique
  • Partenaire Anthropic Select au sein du Claude Partner Network
  • 15 ans de partenariat avec Google Cloud, AWS, Microsoft, Databricks, Confluent...
  • +5000 personnes formées par an via le SFEIR Institute
Rejoindre SFEIR, c'est intégrer un collectif où la culture technique prévaut. Nous offrons des trajectoires de carrière dédiées aux experts (Individual Contributor / IC), te permettant de progresser en haute maîtrise technique sans devoir basculer vers du management organisationnel. Nous intégrons l'IA à nos propres pratiques d'ingénierie (utilisation quotidienne de RAISE et Claude Code) pour automatiser les tâches à faible valeur ajoutée et concentrer nos efforts sur la conception d'architectures résilientes.

▪️ À propos de la mission

Pour accompagner la forte croissance de notre collectif Sud-Ouest, nous recherchons notre futur Architecte Cloud confirmé (F/H/NB).

Tes missions au quotidien :

  • Concevoir et déployer des architectures Cloud performantes et scalables (AWS, GCP, IaaS/PaaS/SaaS) adaptées aux besoins métiers et techniques
  • Piloter la migration d’applications et de workloads vers le Cloud, en choisissant les meilleures options (microservices, conteneurs Docker/Kubernetes, serverless, bases de données cloud)
  • Appliquer et promouvoir les bonnes pratiques DevOps et CI/CD (Jenkins, GitLab CI, Terraform, Ansible, ArgoCD) pour garantir performance, automatisation et fiabilité des déploiements
  • Assurer la sécurité et la conformité des environnements (IAM, KMS, VPC, chiffrement, audit, bonnes pratiques Cloud Security)
  • Collaborer avec les équipes DevOps, architectes et métiers pour garantir la cohérence technique et l’efficacité opérationnelle
  • Participer à la transformation Agile des projets Cloud et à l’amélioration continue des processus
  • Documenter les solutions et former les équipes clientes pour favoriser l’autonomie sur les environnements déployés

▪️ Le profil idéal

  • Expérience : Tu justifies d'au moins 5 ans d'expérience réussie en ingénierie et architecture Cloud (AWS ou GCP), avec une vraie pratique du terrain et du code d'infrastructure.

  • Expertise IaC & DevOps : Tu maîtrises l'automatisation via Terraform/Ansible, l'écosystème Kubernetes et les déploiements continus (ArgoCD/GitLab CI).

  • Culture d'Ingénierie : Tu possèdes une vision globale du SI (sécurité, réseau, stockage, FinOps) et tu aimes transmettre tes convictions techniques auprès des équipes de développement comme des décideurs.

▪️ L'ancrage Bordelais

L'agence SFEIR Bordeaux regroupe une quinzaine d'ingénieurs et d'architectes seniors. Tu y trouveras la proximité et l'agilité d'une structure à taille humaine, adossée à la solidité d'un grand groupe. Tu participes activement à l'écosystème tech local (meetups, conférences BDX/IO, SFEIR Talks) et tu peux intégrer le programme AI Champions pour piloter la R&D de l'agence.

▪️ Tes conditions de travail 

  • Organisation : 2 à 3 jours de télétravail par semaine.
  • Équipement : Laptop haut de gamme au choix (MacBook Pro ou Dell Precision dernière génération).
  • Package : Rémunération fixe attractive, prime de vacances, accord d'intéressement, forfait mobilités durables, mutuelle et titres-restaurant.

▪️ Le processus de recrutement 

  1. Échange RH : Alignement sur ton parcours, tes attentes et les opportunités SFEIR.
  2. Session Technique ("PlayOffs") : Évaluation pratique en pair-programming (Algo, AWS ou GCP avec du Terraform) avec deux Sfeirians. 
  3. Échange Métier & Projection : Discussion approfondie sur les cas d'usage, les missions cibles et le contexte client à Bordeaux.
  4. Entretien Final : Échange stratégique avec le Directeur d'Agence.

 

Tu souhaites faire évoluer ta pratique de l'architecture Cloud au sein d'un collectif d'experts ? Postule et échangeons directement sur tes projets d'avenir !

Du verantwortest eines oder mehrere unserer Kundenprojekte im Customer Service und bist die zentrale Ansprechperson für unsere Auftraggeber. jobs.title: Solutions Architect f/m/d
jobs.description:
Apaleo is the world's most open, API-first property management platform powering the next generation of hospitality operations. Its modular, AI-powered infrastructure enables hoteliers to customise their tech stack, automate routine work, and deliver seamless, personalised guest experiences, powered by best-in-class apps and autonomous AI agents that adapt to every stay.

Why this role

You are the technical voice in front of strategic customers, at a moment when hospitality is being rebuilt around AI. We are launching our own AI agent platform, and we need architects who can show operators what comes next.

  • High trust. You own the technical answer in front of strategic customers and deals.
  • High visibility. Your work shows up in deals, key accounts and customer stories, and it reaches Product.
  • High freedom. You decide how to solve a problem, which tools to use and what to prototype.
  • Fast iteration. We test ideas within days, try new technology early and share what works.

Your mission

Win and grow strategic accounts with technical credibility, and turn what you learn in the field into input for the product. You look at a customer's current architecture and show how an Apaleo-centred setup delivers their goals. You also help them put AI agents to work, deciding what should be an agent, what it costs and how to set it up. Sales and Account Management own the relationship and the commercial terms. You own the technical answer.

What you will do

  • Technical discovery and solution scoping. Lead discovery where a standard demo is not enough. Write clear scopes covering what Apaleo delivers natively, what needs a short-term solution and what is out of scope.
  • Proofs of concept. Build fast, working proofs of concept (quick demos that show technical fit). Agree scope in writing first, and build in a safe test environment, never with live guest data.
  • Agents and automations. Design and build agents and automations for customer use cases, using n8n or Make today and Apaleo's own AI agent platform as it launches. Write code where agents need deterministic steps.
  • Hands-on delivery and short-term solutions. Work alongside the customer, building only where it unblocks a named deal, removes an adoption risk or fills a product gap. Agree an exit plan (an end date, a replacement and a named owner) before you start.
  • Post-sale health checks and expansions. Diagnose gaps against the go-live specification, run proactive checks (for example 90 days after go-live) and scope integrations for expanding customers.
  • Reusable assets. Turn every engagement into a reference architecture, pattern or template that the next twenty customers can use.
  • Thought leadership. Join prospect and customer conversations on how AI will change hospitality over the next two to three years.
  • Product feedback. Test new technology on real customer problems. Share prototypes and field evidence with Product, ending every experiment with a clear decision: adopt, hand over or drop.

How you work

  • You decide the approach, the stack and the order of work.
  • You protect three guardrails: written scope before a proof of concept, an exit plan before a custom build and no commercial promises.
  • You go from idea to prototype in days and show it early.
  • You think in systems and build for reuse, not one-off projects.
  • You share findings openly with Sales, Account Management and Product.

Who you work with

Sales/BD and Account Management (they call you in at defined deal triggers), Customer Success, Product, Security, Partnerships, RevOps and Senior Leadership. 

What you bring

Must have

  • Multiple years in solution architecture, solution engineering or technical consulting in B2B SaaS, ideally with complex software such as ERP or enterprise platforms
  • Strong API skills: REST, authentication, webhooks and events, and data-flow design
  • Hands-on workflow automation (n8n preferred) and practical experience building with LLM agents
  • A systems thinker with real AI curiosity, who uses AI tools day to day
  • Stakeholder management experience and credibility with executives and IT teams
  • Self-direction, an ownership mindset and the discipline to say no to scope that does not advance a deal
  • Curiosity that ends in working prototypes, not just opinions
  • Clear, structured documentation habits
  • Fluent English and French skills
  • Willingness to travel, including regularly to France and the UK

Strong plus

  • Hospitality or travel experience, including hotel operations and PMS concepts (reservations, folios, rate plans, night audit)
  • Experience with another cloud PMS, channel manager or payments integrations
  • Enterprise architecture experience on large, multi-site projects
  • Applied AI or ML background, or experience with MCP and agent platforms
  • SQL and BI fundamentals

How we measure success

  • Architecture engagements and blueprints delivered each quarter
  • Customer satisfaction with your contribution
  • Adoption of recommended apps, integrations and agents
  • Share of engagements served by an existing reusable pattern
  • Revenue impact e.g. deal unblocked, AI adoption, or churn averted

Your first 90 days

  • Days 1 to 30: Learn the platform and ways of working, shadow discovery and proof of concept work, and take over open customer projects.
  • Days 31 to 60: Lead technical discovery on live deals and run your first health check with Account Management.
  • Days 61 to 90: Deliver a proof of concept or short-term solution end to end with an exit plan, and share your first experiment with Product.

 

What We Offer

Culture & Growth

  • A Diverse & International Team: Work alongside passionate professionals from over 20 nationalities, bringing unique cultural perspectives, backgrounds, and experiences to shape the future of hospitality tech.
  • Growth & Development: As we scale, so do your opportunities. You'll benefit from 360° feedback reviews, a dedicated learning budget, and plenty of chances to take on more responsibility. Our evolving career framework ensures you have increasing opportunities to learn new skills, advance your career, and make an impact.
  • Autonomy & Ownership: Great ideas can come from anywhere. We empower you to take responsibility, make decisions, and contribute directly in an environment built on trust, transparency, and collaboration.
  • Shape the Future of Hospitality Tech: Be part of a fast-growing scale-up transforming the hospitality industry. From day one, your work drives real impact and you'll have the freedom to bring your ideas to life.
  • Competitive & Fair Compensation: We believe great work deserves great pay. Our salaries are competitive and guided by benchmarking data to ensure fairness across all roles and teams. We make sure to recognize and reward performance and contribution.

Perks & Lifestyle

  • Flexible & Remote Work Options: We focus on results, not clocking hours. You can work from home, the office or in a hybrid setup, with flexibility to adapt your schedule as long as it makes sense for your role, your team and our business.
  • Team Connection: Strong connections fuel collaboration. We celebrate and connect through regular team dinners, company meetups, Oktoberfest celebrations, Christmas parties, and other offsite events.
  • Paid Time Off: Enjoy 30 days of vacation to fully disconnect, recharge, and return inspired.
  • Health & Wellbeing: Prioritize your health with access to hundreds of gyms, fitness studios, and wellness options through our EGYM Wellpass membership.

How you make an impact joining Apaleo: Joining Apaleo means more than just taking on a role it's about driving real change in the hospitality industry. Your contributions will directly shape our innovative platform, influence company-wide decisions, and help redefine the future of hospitality tech. At Apaleo, your voice matters, your ideas are valued, and your impact is tangible. Be part of a team where your work fuels progress, collaboration sparks innovation, and growth is a shared journey.

We celebrate differences and believe that diversity enriches our team and drives innovation.

Your role

As Quality & Training Manager, you will create and lead the Quality & Training activity for the whole HousingAnywhere Group, covering the Operations teams in Cergy and Rotterdam. You define its scope, methods and tools, and you are responsible for service quality and operational practices across the Group.

You work closely with the managers of the Customer Support and Booking Ops teams to structure training, onboarding, quality monitoring and performance tooling.

The role is based in France, with frequent travel to our Rotterdam office. English is the main working language.

Building the Quality & Training activity

Training & onboarding

  • Identify the training needs of the Ops teams, and accompany the integration process while migrating to a single operating model in 2027,
  • Develop complete training programmes covering customer service posture, tools, and day-to-day processes and procedures,
  • Create and maintain training materials (scripts, practical guides, process sheets, e-learning content), working with the other departments like Product for new features,
  • Run a structured onboarding and support new joiners in live situations after initial training, to bridge theory and practice,
  • Carry out an individual assessment at the end of onboarding (audits, call listening, double listening, tests) and provide personalised follow-up,
  • Lead group and one-to-one sessions, on-the-spot debriefs and targeted coaching on the fundamentals: call handling, request qualification, rephrasing, quality of written and spoken answers, and CRM data entry,
  • Train teams on new procedures and tool changes as they are rolled out.

Quality & operational performance

  • Define and roll out quality standards and control frameworks for each team, across the full user journey,
  • Build structured quality reporting by individual, team and business unit, with a monthly report to managers,

Knowledge management

Cross-functional collaboration

  • Contribute to Voice of Customer and customer satisfaction projects by sharing pain points identified through quality monitoring,
  • Propose initiatives to align operational practices with company strategy and the user experience.
  • Advise and support managers on using tools and analysing performance.

 

Your profile

  • 5+ years of experience in training, quality management or quality monitoring of customer service or operations teams.
  • Experience building a quality or training activity from scratch, or a strong drive to do so,
  • Experience setting up a quality monitoring programme (call listening, audits, calibration),

  • Comfortable with CRM and telephony tools, e-learning content creation and performance dashboards,
  • Fluent English and French are required. English is the main working language,
  • Willingness to travel frequently to Rotterdam.

 

Why this opportunity?

  • A newly created role: you build the Group's Quality & Training activity from the ground up.

At Harvey, we’re transforming how legal and professional services operate. By combining frontier agentic AI, an enterprise-grade platform, and deep domain expertise, we’re reshaping how critical knowledge work gets done for decades to come.

This is a rare chance to help build a generational company at a true inflection point. We have strong product-market fit and world-class investor support. We’re scaling fast and defining a new category in real time. The work is ambitious, the bar is high, and the opportunity for growth — personal, professional, and financial — is unmatched.

Our team moves fast, takes ownership, and is deeply committed to the mission — operating with intensity, staying close to our customers, and pushing each other for excellence. We live by three values: Decisiveness, Simplicity, and Job's Not Finished. We act quickly on clear judgment over perfect information, we believe simplicity is what scales, and we're never satisfied with where we are. If you want to do the best work of your career alongside people who share that drive, we'd love to build with you.

At Harvey, the future of professional services is being written today — and we’re just getting started.

Role Overview

Harvey’s Legal Engineers are skilled lawyers from top-tier law firms who apply their legal experience to ensure that current and prospective customers understand how Harvey’s solutions enhance specific day-to-day workflows, working alongside Harvey’s Account Executives to support all aspects of our sales strategy. Legal Engineers build consultative relationships with law firm partners and associates and in-house attorneys at private equity firms and Fortune 500 companies, becoming trusted advisors on how Harvey’s AI solutions can make them more effective.

Similar to the way Solutions Architects secure the “technical win” in the sales process, Legal Engineers secure the “legal win” by performing in-depth customer discovery and education on Harvey’s solutions through targeted meetings and demos that resonate with the customer’s day-to-day workflows specific to their legal practice area.

Legal Engineers utilize their experience practicing law and their legal mindset to ask thoughtful questions to understand the needs of law firm and in-house attorneys, develop credibility, and then partner with Account Executives to educate them on Harvey’s value via large and small group sessions as well as one-to-one conversations.

What You'll Do

  • Engage with lawyers at existing and prospective customers to understand and address their workflow challenges, and then explain and demonstrate the value of Harvey’s AI solutions to address them.

  • Establish yourself as a credible expert in solving customers’ specific legal problems (e.g. researching public and private databases for certain types of information, drafting and analyzing contractual provisions and whole documents, analyzing briefs and filings, corporate governance, conducting due diligence).

  • Lead product demonstrations tailored to the context of various law firm practice groups and in-house legal teams, asking questions to validate how Harvey can add value and then showcasing Harvey’s features and benefits relevant to each prospective client’s potential use cases.

  • Partner with the marketing team to develop content that will resonate with lawyers, tailored to the unique needs of their practice areas and client types.

  • Act as the “Voice of the Customer,” using your legal perspective to help the broader sales team to develop and implement more effective strategies and synthesize customer feedback for the product team through a legal lens.

  • Tailor the introduction of new solutions to specific customer needs.

  • Further the market perception of Harvey as uniquely credible, substantive, and helpful in applying its AI solutions to make lawyers better at their jobs.

  • Conduct research and analysis on customers and competitors.

  • Travel may be required from time to time, including visits to customer office locations and company offices.

What You Have

  • Must be qualified to practice law in England & Wales, with at least 3 years of experience practicing law at a top-tier law firm in the U.K.

  • Fluent or Native Arabic speaker

  • Executive engagement skills and presence, with an ability to establish strong relationships with key decision makers and build credibility at all levels

  • Outstanding presentation skills to both legal and executive audiences, whether impromptu on a whiteboard or using presentations and demos.

  • Strong understanding of legal processes and challenges faced by legal professionals.

  • Curiosity about AI’s potential to transform the legal industry.

  • Sales or customer-facing experience, including law firm business development and/or secondment, is a plus, as is experience directly managing law firm client matters and client relationships.

jobs.title: Copy of Research Scientist / Engineer – Performance Optimization
jobs.description:
You'll make Luma's multimodal models fast — profiling and optimizing GPU, CPU, and accelerator code so they train efficiently and deploy at scale without sacrificing quality. You'll write the kernels and operations that get the most out of the hardware.

This is deep performance work: fused kernels, tensor cores, Triton and CUDA, distributed multi-node deployment. It fits someone with expert GPU-optimization skills and a deep understanding of transformer internals. If you're not at home in CUDA, Triton, and profilers, this is the wrong depth.

What You'll Own

  • Profile and optimize GPU/CPU/accelerator code for maximum utilization and minimal latency.

  • Write high-performance PyTorch, Triton, and CUDA, dropping to custom operations when needed.

  • Develop fused kernels and leverage tensor cores and modern hardware features across platforms.

  • Optimize model architectures and implementations for distributed multi-node production deployment.

  • Build performance monitoring and analysis tools and automation.

  • Research and implement cutting-edge optimization techniques for transformer models.

First 90 Days

One way the first 90 could unfold.

  • Days 1–30 — Immerse & Diagnose: Profile the current training and inference paths and find the biggest performance wins.

  • Days 30–60 — Ship & Validate: Land a kernel or architecture optimization that measurably improves utilization or latency.

  • Days 60–90 — Scale & Systemize: Build the monitoring and automation that keeps performance gains from regressing.

What You Bring

  • Expert-level Triton/CUDA programming and GPU optimization.

  • Strong PyTorch skills, including kernel development and custom operations.

  • Proficiency with profiling tools (NVIDIA Nsight, torch profiler, custom tooling).

  • Deep understanding of transformer architectures and attention mechanisms.

Nice to Have

  • Experience with compilers and exporters (torch.compile, TensorRT, ONNX, XLA).

  • Experience optimizing inference workloads for latency and throughput.

  • Triton compiler and kernel fusion techniques.

  • Knowledge of warp-level intrinsics and advanced CUDA optimization.

About Luma: Luma's mission is to build unified general intelligence that can generate, understand, and operate in the physical world. We believe multimodality is critical for intelligence — the next step beyond language models comes from vision. Luma is an equal opportunity employer.

This is a hands-on leadership role at the center of our EMEA Customer Success organization.

You'll lead a small, senior team of 5 with the intention to double to 10 in the next 12 months.

Based from London, your team sit locally along with a growing team in Munich and possibly Riyadh in future working with enterprise customers across EMEA.

Where You Come In

You'll carry formal accountability for your team's performance, development, hiring, and day-to-day effectiveness — and you'll stay personally engaged in the region's most strategic accounts, at the level where a senior voice changes the outcome. Your core mandate is to turn a set of excellent individual practices into one operating system: the account planning, escalation, and reporting structures that let the team scale without a proportional rise in headcount.

This fits someone who wants to lead from close range rather than inherit a large, already-built org. If you're looking for a defined playbook or a steady renewal book to protect, this isn't that — you'll be building the playbook as you go.

What You'll Own

  • Lead the EMEA Customer Success team — owning hiring, onboarding, coaching, performance management, and career development for a small group of senior CSMs.

  • Stay personally engaged in the region's most strategic accounts, holding senior relationships directly and stepping in when a situation needs a decision at your level.

  • Decide where the team's time goes: which accounts warrant depth, what account enablement work is worth the investment, and what should become a repeatable, templated motion versus a bespoke one-off.

  • Build the account planning, escalation, and reporting processes that let the team absorb more enterprise customers without adding headcount at the same rate.

  • Own performance outcomes for the accounts the team covers — net revenue retention, retention rates, health score distribution, and escalation resolution — and report cleanly to leadership.

  • Grow usage inside existing accounts — across more teams, more markets, and more use cases

  • Partner cross-functionally with Sales on renewals and new-account expansion, with Forward Deployed Creatives on workflow adoption, and with Product on what customers in the region need built next.

  • Identify and develop talent — building a bench of strong individual contributors and emerging player-coaches who can grow with the organization.

  • Lead hiring for the team as it scales, setting an explicit bar for what "senior" looks like in EMEA Customer Success.

  • Set and maintain a high standard of execution across the team: account health, CRM hygiene, renewal management, expansion identification, and customer engagement quality.

  • Serve as a senior point of escalation for complex customer situations that have exceeded what the team can resolve independently.

  • Contribute to CS strategy alongside regional and functional leadership — bringing a ground-level view of team capability, customer patterns, and operational gaps into planning conversations.

Who You Are

  • 10+ years of experience in Customer Success or a closely related client-facing function, including substantial experience leading teams of senior individual contributors (not only early-career CSMs) with direct accountability for performance outcomes.

  • A proven people manager — you've built and developed CS teams, navigated performance conversations with directness and care, and have a track record of retention and growth among your reports.

  • A record of personally holding senior relationships at large enterprise or agency accounts, including the conversations that go badly.

  • Evidence you've made a team's work repeatable — you've taken a function running on effort and given it a system, and can say what you cut to get there.

  • Strong operational leader — you build reliable execution systems, hold teams to consistent standards, and are comfortable owning outcome metrics rather than just activity metrics.

  • Presence — you can lead people who already know their job well, in a region removed from headquarters, and earn their respect quickly while holding your own point of view.

  • Comfortable operating across multiple markets within the region while working closely with a leadership team based elsewhere.

  • Effective cross-functional partner — you work well with Sales, Product, and GTM leaders and understand how CS fits into the broader revenue motion.

  • Comfortable operating in a scaling environment where team structure, tooling, and process are still being refined — you improve the system rather than waiting for it to be finished.

What Sets You Apart

  • Experience building or significantly scaling a CS function at a high-growth startup — including hiring, process development, and team structure design.

  • Fluency with marketers — real time spent working with advertising agencies or brand marketing teams, whether from a software vendor, a media owner, an ad tech or martech company, or from inside an agency or brand.

  • Background at a creative technology, generative AI, or product-led growth company.

  • Track record of developing CS managers or leads from IC backgrounds — not just hiring experienced managers externally.

  • Deep familiarity with CRM and customer success tooling, and a point of view on how to use data to manage team performance.

Nice to Have

  • An additional European language.

  • Experience at a creative software, martech, or ad tech company selling into agency groups and global brands.

  • Familiarity with adjacent, newly-opened markets relevant to the region's growth (e.g. the Middle East).

Quantum Systems is a leading European deep-tech company for unmanned systems across air, land and maritime domains. We develop and scale integrated hardware, software and AI-powered solutions for mission-critical operations. By combining autonomous platforms with intelligent software and AI, Quantum Systems enables customers to operate, understand and act across domains.

We are looking for a C-UAS Training & Demo Expert who combines practical hardware skills with the ability to deliver clear customer training and professional demonstrations.

As part of our Training & Demo team, you prepare equipment and deliver customer training and demonstrations for C-UAS systems. You help customers understand system capabilities and limitations, and guide them in safe, responsible operation.

You enjoy working directly with hardware, from assembly and functional checks to troubleshooting. You turn technical content into clear training materials and practical exercises, assess participants’ progress and document results. Working closely with Sales, Engineering and Product teams, you share customer feedback and recurring technical issues to improve training and product usability. You support international customer engagements and ensure that every activity follows applicable safety requirements and local regulations.


What is your Day to Day Mission:

  • Conduct engaging product demonstrations, incorporating your prior mission experience to facilitate use cases for future customers (which range from operator up to ministerial decision-maker level).

  • Conduct hands-on flight training sessions for our C-UAS products.

  • Ensuring completion and function of C-UAS equipment before traveling to locations worldwide to conduct product demonstrations and/or training.

  • Creation of engaging instructional materials, including manuals, presentations, and practical exercises. Maintaining this training documentation in German and/or English.

  • Developing realistic C-UAS training scenarios reflecting current UAV and FPV threats and use structured debriefings to improve future training.

  • Coordinate training and demonstration activities with customer teams, site operators and relevant authorities to ensure safe and compliant execution.

  • Guide pre-flight checks, flight planning, post-flight and post-processing procedures.

  • Assess trainee performance during both theoretical and practical training sessions. Provide constructive feedback and guidance to enhance skills and proficiency.




What you bring to the team:

  • You have 3+ years of experience in UAS operations, flight testing or field engineering in defence, aerospace or RC.

  • You hold valid drone pilot qualifications for A1/A2/A3 and STS 1 & STS 2 or are willing to obtain them quickly.

  • You have hands-on FPV piloting experience and understand FPV UAV capabilities, limitations and flight characteristics. Experience with turbine-powered model aircraft is a plus.

  • You understand C-UAS detection, identification, tracking and threat assessment, and can explain system capabilities and limitations in an operational context. Relevant C-UAS experience or a military, police or security background is an advantage.

  • You have a strong understanding of flight operations, safety procedures and airspace regulations (EASA or equivalent).

  • You have practical experience with one or more of the following: radio systems, antennas, telemetry, GNSS, radar, video links or long-range communication.

  • You can independently plan, deliver and evaluate customer training in German and/or English.

  • You explain technical topics clearly, give constructive feedback and present confidently to technical and non-technical audiences.

  • You are willing to travel worldwide and work outdoors in demanding conditions, while consistently following safety procedures and local regulations.

  • A valid Class B driving licence is required.


Why Quantum-Systems:

  • We believe in the power of combined efforts: straightforward tech expertise paired with a customer-centric focus.

jobs.title: Technical Recruiter (Berlin)
jobs.description:
Who we are

Foundation models transformed text and images. Structured data - the largest and most consequential data format in the world - stayed untouched, until now. What LLMs did for language, we're doing for tables.

We pioneered tabular foundation models: TabPFN v2 was a Nature cover story, has passed 3.5M+ downloads and 7,500+ GitHub stars, and runs in production from detecting lung disease with Oxford Cancer Analytics to preventing train failures with Hitachi. The hardest problems - millions of rows, real-time inference, entirely new modalities - are still open, and no one else is working on them at this level.

We're a small, highly selective team of 40+ with backgrounds from Google, DeepMind, Meta, Apple, Amazon, Jane Street, and CERN, led by Frank Hutter, Noah Hollmann, and Sauraj Gambhir, and advised by Bernhard Schölkopf and Turing Award winner Yann LeCun.

In July 2026, less than 18 months after our €9M pre-seed, we joined SAP as an independent frontier AI lab - same team, mission, and open-weights models, now backed by more than €1 billion over four years.

About the Role

We're hiring a technical recruiter to own hiring across Science, Engineering and Data Science. These are three distinct talent markets with three distinct assessment bars, and you'll own all of them end-to-end. We're scaling fast, and competing directly with the best-funded labs in the world for the same people.

Your Responsibilities

  • Source scarce ML research, infrastructure, and forward-deployed talent globally, exploring mainstream and niche talent pools

  • Position Prior Labs compellingly against other foundation model labs such as OpenAI, Anthropic, DeepMind, and Mistral and against the enterprise AI companies competing for FDE talent

  • Navigate multi-hub hiring across Freiburg, Berlin, and New York (visas, comp bands, notice periods)

  • Screen technical depth quickly across research, engineering, and customer-facing profiles without burning researcher or founder time

  • Run efficient, structured interview loops with clear rubrics and fast debriefs, calibrated separately for research, engineering, and FDE archetypes

  • Manage, negotiate and close offers, including against competing frontier-lab packages

  • Manage the pipeline operationally in the ATS with clean stages and weekly metrics

The experience we are looking for

  • 5+ years in-house technical recruiting at a deep-tech, AI/ML, or research-led startup (Series A and ), or in a frontier lab's talent team

  • Track record closing ML researchers or research engineers against top tier frontier labs (e.g. OpenAI, Anthropic, DeepMind, Mistral)

  • Experience hiring at least one customer-facing engineering profile (forward deployed, solutions, or applied engineering) — the assessment bar is different and you'll need to know why

  • Hands-on hiring across at least two of: Germany, wider EU, and the US (NYC)

  • Fluency in the ML talent landscape: top labs, conferences (NeurIPS, ICML, ICLR, AutoML), and what distinguishes a strong research vs. engineering vs. infrastructure profile

  • Modern ATS architecture (Ashby or equivalent): stage design, rejection taxonomy, funnel reporting

The behaviours we want you to bring everyday to the office

  • High agency and ownership and operates as a full stack recruiter

  • Direct and commercially honest with both candidates and hiring managers

  • Detail-obsessed on pipeline hygiene and weekly metrics; treats the ATS as a source of truth

Location: 5 days a week based in our Berlin Office (near Rosa-Luxemburg-Straße U-Bahn Station)

Life at Prior Labs

You'll work alongside researchers and builders who hold themselves to a very high bar - in the quality of their work and in how they work with each other. We move fast and still take the time to do things right.

Our teams are based in Berlin, Freiburg, and New York - when you're working on something as hard as TabPFN, being in the same room matters. But great people come from everywhere, and in exceptional cases we're open to remote, which usually means frequent travel to one of our offices. Wherever you're based, the whole company comes together regularly for offsites to build and celebrate together.

Our Commitments

The best products and teams are built by people with a wide range of perspectives and backgrounds. We welcome applications from all identities and walks of life - especially if you've ever felt discouraged by "not checking every box" - and provide equal opportunities regardless of gender, sexual orientation, origin, disability, or any other trait that makes you who you are.

New and more sustainable building materials already exist, yet many struggle to make the leap into real construction projects. You will be the senior technical voice for OTA in Germany — driving site development activities, setting technical direction, mentoring engineers, and ensuring the Germany team's contributions integrate cleanly into a single, global OTA architecture.

This role is based in our Berlin office and requires a minimum of three days per week onsite, with occasional travel to other company and partner sites as needed.

  • Collaborate daily with the OTA development team in Palo Alto on system architecture, API contracts, and release planning; ensure Germany-site work streams stay aligned with the global OTA roadmap.

  • Partner with QA, functional safety, cybersecurity, and vehicle integration teams to validate updates through bench, HIL, and vehicle-level testing.

  • Support root-cause analysis and resolution of field issues related to update failures, mismatches, or rollback scenarios.

  • Take a leading role in architecture reviews and design decisions for the global OTA platform, representing Germany-site needs and constraints while upholding overall system coherence.

  • Experience directly interfacing with a partner engineering team in a different location/time zone to align on architecture and delivery.

  • Experience with version control, code review workflows, and CI/CD for embedded or systems software.

  • Working knowledge of cryptographic concepts used in secure software delivery: digital signatures, certificate/key management, and secure boot chains.

  • Strong debugging skills across layers — application logic, OS/driver interaction, and hardware/bus-level communication.

  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Electrical/Computer Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

  • Fluent English (spoken and written) for daily collaboration with the Palo Alto team; German language skills are a plus for local site interactions.

  • Willingness to travel occasionally to Palo Alto, CA (or host virtual overlap hours) to support cross-site architecture and planning.

jobs.title: Founding Engineer (all genders)
jobs.description:
Gynaecological care the way it's supposed to be: Personalised, easy to reach, effective.

Women are diagnosed on average four years later than men, across 770 different diseases. They spend 25 % more of their lives in poor health. That is the gender health gap, and science says two things keep it open: too little access to specialists in women's health, and far too little research on women in the first place.

femote works on both.

Step One: we turn ordinary statutory gynaecological practices into digital care champions. So that the specialists we do have can care for more patients properly, within the resources they are given.

Step Two: we turn generalist doctors into specialists by equipping them with clinical diagnostic and decision support built specifically for women's health, trained on data collected by Step One.

Where we stand

  • Supported by leaders of the German gynaecological medical associations
  • Backed by industry angels from pharmaceuticals and medical publishing
  • Innovation grant secured from the German Federal Ministry for Economic Affairs and Energy
  • Part of the Lausitz Model Region, giving us deep integration into the statutory system and reach to women regardless of their spending power
  • MVP in pilot phase with real practices (Stack: Flutter, Supabase, Postgres. Up for debate once you join)
  • Pre-seed stage, with funding in place to bring you on

Tasks

We are looking for our first engineer to build femote's product and shape the technical foundation it grows on.

As our founding engineer, you will build our first SaaS product, a patient app and a professional interface, under European General Product Safety Regulation guidelines in the first year while we prepare for medical device certification in year two.

Every case we capture is structured so it can carry clinical evidence later, which is what makes algorithmic and decision-support features possible at all. You will not build those alone, but you need to direct that work, and the architecture that makes it possible has to be laid now.

Requirements

We value smartness, humility and the ability to learn and adapt quickly over hard skills on paper. Please apply, even if you don't tick all the boxes.

What you have done

  • Experience running a SaaS product from building to shipping to operating in production
  • Strong data modelling and processing, including consent, provenance and pseudonymisation, so captured data can lawfully support clinical evidence and model training later
  • Bonus: experience building algorithmic or AI-enabled features
  • Bonus: experience building in a regulated field (MDR, AI Act, or similar)
  • Bonus: German speaking, though not required

How you work

  • You ship fast without lowering the bar. Short iteration cycles and pragmatic solutions, with engineering practices solid enough to stand up to a notified body.
  • You set the pattern, not just the code. Everything the first engineer does becomes the default for everyone after. You write it down, you teach it, and you build with that in mind.
  • You do not think in taboos. You will be reading about discharge, bleeding and pelvic pain at nine in the morning and building interfaces for it. If that is awkward for you, this is not your role.
  • You want to understand why we are doing this in gynaecology. You do not have to arrive as an expert in women's health, and we are happy to offer a steep learning curve. The curiosity has to be yours.
  • You are reflective. You take feedback without putting armour on, and you say when you are stuck rather than when it is already too late.

Benefits

  • Meaningful equity as hurdle shares or an instrument with equivalent tax treatment.
  • Genuine ownership of the technical direction
  • Full-time, with flexible working hours
  • Room to grow into the CTO role: owning medical device certification, security and data handling, the engineering team you hire around you, and representing femote's technical direction to regulators, partners and investors.

Our hiring process

  1. Conversation with Frederike (45 min): what we are building, what you have built, and whether this is the right fit for both sides.
  2. Meet the team: Tabea and Insa, the people you will work with every day.
  3. Technical deep dive with one of our technical advisors: architecture, data modelling and how you would approach our product.
  4. Offer.

From application to offer takes no longer than six weeks.

Who you will work with

We are a small team, and between us we have treated patients, built data infrastructure and products for enterprise clients, and studied how health systems fail people at scale.

Our team is technical enough that you don't have to translate engineering reality into business language.

Frederike Kugland, Founder: Quit her job for yeast infections. Built a company around it.
WHU graduate turned developer. Ex-Managing Partner at tech consultancy Pandata. Learned to code because she hated Excel, now runs product, fundraising and sales. Technical enough to be your sparring partner but too busy to interfere with your work. Doesn't shy away from founder-led marketing, discussing her intimate health on the Gyncast Podcast.

Dr. med. Tabea Siebler, Medical Lead: Doctor. Polyglot. One exam room isn't enough for her.
Certified gynaecologist, speaks 6 languages, not as a Duolingo streak but to serve her patients. Implemented a new consultation hour for Female Genital Mutilation and Cutting at her last clinic. Currently studying Public Health at the London School of Hygiene because treating one patient at a time wasn't enough.

Insa Deden, Software Development: Left the ward to build what was missing on it.
Trained and worked as a registered nurse in anaesthesia at University Medical Center Hamburg-Eppendorf, then went to study health information management to work on the problems she had been living with every shift. She brings the care-delivery perspective that sits next to Tabea's clinical one: what it actually takes for software to hold up at scale in daily practice, rather than in a demo. Moving from working student to full-time.

Alongside them: a fractional CFO, regulatory and compliance support from the former Head of Regulatory at Heidelberg Engineering, and technical advisors.

jobs.title: Senior Consultant (m/w/d)
jobs.description:
Wir suchen

Wir suchen einen Senior Consultant, der mit uns die digitale Transformation im Kundenumfeld der Sozialversicherung gestaltet. In dieser Rolle begleitest du unsere Kunden von der ersten Idee bis zur erfolgreichen Umsetzung, analysierst Geschäftsprozesse und entwickelst fachliche und digitale Lösungen für moderne Verwaltungs- und Leistungsprozesse. Dabei arbeitest du eng mit Kunden und Partnern zusammen und bringst deine Ideen aktiv ein, um nachhaltige Verbesserungen zu schaffen und echte Mehrwerte zu erzielen.


Was Dich erwartet

Die digitale Sozialversicherung von morgen gestalten: Du unterstützt Träger und Organisationen der Sozialversicherung bei der Digitalisierung und Modernisierung ihrer Fach- und Verwaltungsprozesse. Dabei begleitest Du unsere Kunden von der strategischen Idee bis zur erfolgreichen Umsetzung und leistest einen aktiven Beitrag zur Weiterentwicklung moderner Verwaltungsleistungen. 
Fachliche Beratung: Du analysierst bestehende Prozesse, erkennst Optimierungs- und Harmonisierungspotenziale und entwickelst gemeinsam mit Kunden nachhaltige Lösungsansätze. Dabei bringst Du eigene Ideen ein und gestaltest die digitale Transformation aktiv mit. 
Anforderungen verstehen – Lösungen entwickeln: Du erfasst, strukturierst und bewertest fachliche Anforderungen aus komplexen Verwaltungs- und Sozialversicherungskontexten. Aus regulatorischen, organisatorischen und fachlichen Vorgaben entwickelst Du praxisnahe Konzepte und begleitest deren Umsetzung. 
Zusammenarbeit auf Augenhöhe: Du koordinierst fachliche Themen zwischen Kunden, Partnerdienstleistern und internen Teams und sorgst dafür, dass unterschiedliche Interessen erfolgreich zusammengeführt werden. Dabei fungierst Du als vertrauenswürdiger Ansprechpartner für alle Projektbeteiligten. 
Projektmanagement: Du übernimmst Projektmanagementaufgaben in Digitalisierungs-, Transformations- und Modernisierungsprojekten. Dabei arbeitest du eng mit Entwicklungsteams zusammen und begleitest die Umsetzung fachlicher Anforderungen in digitale Lösungen. Von der Planung über die Steuerung bis zur Umsetzung behältst Du Termine, Abhängigkeiten und Projektergebnisse im Blick. 
Workshops und Wissenstransfer: Du planst, moderierst und dokumentierst Workshops, Fachgespräche und Abstimmungsrunden mit Kunden, Partnern und Stakeholdern. Darüber hinaus vertrittst Du fachliche Themen in Gremien und Arbeitsgruppen und unterstützt den nachhaltigen Wissenstransfer. 
Qualität und Kundenerfolg: Durch strukturierte Beratung, zielgerichtetes Projektmanagement und partnerschaftliche Zusammenarbeit unterstützt Du unsere Kunden dabei, ihre Transformation erfolgreich umzusetzen.


Dein Profil

  • Kontaktfreude, Kommunikationsstärke und ausgeprägte Kundenorientierung  
  • Verantwortungsbewusstsein, selbstständige Arbeitsweise und sicheres Auftreten in Workshops und Gremien  
  • Fähigkeit, komplexe Zusammenhänge klar und verständlich darzustellen  
  • Fähigkeit, unterschiedliche Interessen zusammenzuführen und tragfähige Lösungen zu entwickeln  
  • Fähigkeit, eigenständig praxisorientierte fachliche Lösungsvorschläge zu entwickeln und komplexe Anforderungen aus regulierten Verwaltungs- und Sozialversicherungskontexten zu bewerten   
  • Bereitschaft zur engen Zusammenarbeit mit Entwicklungsteams im Rahmen der Umsetzung fachlicher Anforderungen 
  • Aufbau nachhaltiger Kundenbeziehungen und fachlicher Netzwerke 
  • Eigenständige Weiterentwicklung fachlicher und strategischer Themen 
  • Bereitschaft zu Reisen sowie zu Einsätzen vor Ort bei Kunden und Partnerdienstleistern  
  • Sehr gute mündliche und schriftliche Ausdrucksfähigkeit in deutscher Sprache  

    Wünschenswert:  
  • Gutes Verständnis von Workflow-Systemen  
  • Projekterfahrung im Umfeld der Sozialversicherung, öffentlicher Auftraggeber oder vergleichbarer regulierter Organisationen  
  • Verständnis für Abläufe und Strukturen in der Sozialversicherung oder öffentlichen Verwaltung  
  • Kenntnisse in ECM/DMS sowie idealerweise in FOM und OM  
  • Erfahrung in der Zusammenarbeit mit Verbänden, Trägerorganisationen oder institutionellen Stakeholdern ist von Vorteil  


Warum wir?

Deine Chance – jetzt und für die Zukunft: 

  • Flexibles Arbeiten: Arbeite vor Ort in einem unserer modernen Büros oder flexibel am mobilen Arbeitsplatz daheim.
  • Teamspirit: Erlebe eine (Familien-) freundliche, wertschätzende Arbeitsatmosphäre im Unternehmen und deinem Team.
  • Kontinuierliches Lernen: Wir unterstützen dich gerne durch interne und externe Weiterbildungen. 
  • Community of Practice: Arbeite in fachbereichübergreifenden Projektgruppen zusammen, tauscht Wissen aus und entwickelt kreative Problemlösungen.

  3. Personalverantwortung für Sales / Business Development 
  4. Steuerung der Geschäftsfeldentwicklung der Division

Dabei analysierst und bewertest Du Markttrends, erkennst neue Potenziale und übersetzt Chancen in eine überzeugende Vision und nachhaltige Wachstumsstrategie.

About us

IGES GmbH specialises in health economic and strategic research and consulting services for international pharmaceutical and medical device manufacturers. It offers biotech, pharmaceutical and medical device companies solutions for market access, pricing and reimbursement of their medical innovations. The company has offices in France, Germany, Italy, Spain, Sweden, Switzerland and the United Kingdom and also provides support for multinational product launches. IGES is part of the Athagoras Group, which brings together various consulting firms for the life sciences industry.

To strengthen our team in the area of Value Strategy & RWE, we are looking for a Senior Consultant Real World Evidence - Focus on Healthcare Data Analysis (m/f/d)


Your mission

  • Design, execution, evaluation and interpretation of analyses based on claims data – in particular health insurance fund data (GKV) and/or registry data – from data preparation through cohort definition to the presentation of results 
  • Interpretation and contextualisation of analysis results to generate robust real-world evidence, and its translation into strategic recommendations for our clients
  • Strategic consulting for market access, HE&OR and RWE departments at leading pharmaceutical companies and emerging biotechs
  • Providing technical oversight and quality assurance for analyses in interdisciplinary projects, as well as mentoring less experienced colleagues
  • Providing support on HTA-related issues (e.g. evidence requirements, PICO scoping, analysis strategies) and translating the results into publications, presentations and project reports
  • Conducting systematic literature reviews and structured evaluations to supplement findings from claims data
  • Active involvement in the further development of internal data and methodological expertise for analyses of health data from the FDZ-Gesundheit
  • Collaboration on the preparation and publication of results, e.g. in scientific journals, project reports and presentations of findings


Your profile

  • Successfully completed degree (master's/diploma) in health services research, public health, health economics, statistics, epidemiology or a comparable field 
  • Several years’ relevant professional experience in the analysis of claims data – in particular health insurance fund data (GKV) and/or register data – in an industrial or academic environment
  • Demonstrable ability to interpret analysis results independently, synthesise them into real-world evidence and present them in a manner tailored to the target audience
  • Proficiency in epidemiological and statistical methods, to the extent required for the practical evaluation of claims data
  • Experience in drafting scientific documents, e.g. study protocols, study reports or publications
  • Programming skills in R or Python would be an advantage
  • Knowledge of HTA/market access requirements is welcome but not essential
  • Analytical thinking, structured and careful working style, and a high degree of initiative
  • Open-minded and communicative personality with a team- and client-oriented approach
  • Fluent written and spoken German and English (academic level)


Our offer

  • Collaboration on varied projects involving highly innovative drugs at the interface of healthcare research, real-world evidence and strategic consulting
  • An interdisciplinary, collegial working environment with flat hierarchies, short decision-making paths and good development prospects
  • Professional and personal development through challenging project work, plenty of scope for your own ideas and individually tailored further training (e.g. conferences)
  • Gain practical experience in using large claims data sets, as well as early development of expertise relating to the FDZ Gesundheit
  • Flexible working arrangements after structured training at the Berlin site, including the option to work from home
  • A Permanent position with competitive remuneration, flexible working hours, 30 days of holiday and additional time off on Christmas Eve and New Year's Eve

Willkommen bei Sanoptis – einem führenden Netzwerk moderner Augenkliniken und augenärztlicher Praxen mit über 580 Standorten in ganz Europa. Gleichzeitig sind sie Teil eines größeren Netzwerks mit starken Partnern, das ihnen Synergieeffekte, modernste Technik und viele weitere Vorteile bietet.

Dein Verantwortungsbereich umfasst die strategische Überwachung, das Leistungsmanagement, die Teamführung und die Zusammenarbeit mit funktionsübergreifenden Teams. In dieser Rolle wirst Du

  • Wachstum durch Standortentwicklung vorantreiben: Du siehst Wachstumschancen in Deiner Region und erkennst sie frühzeitig, um sie gewinnbringend zu nutzen. Du wirst durch effektive Marketing- und Werbestrategien zur Steigerung des Patientenaufkommens in enger Zusammenarbeit mit dem Marketingteam beitragen. Dein Ziel ist es, einen Ausbau des Marktanteils zu erreichen.


Du wirst zusammenarbeiten mit

  • Einem starken Operationsteam, bestehend aus vielen Ex-Beratern (Bain, BCG, Roland Berger, Oliver Wyman).

Dein Profil überzeugt durch

jobs.title: Senior Analytics Engineer
jobs.description:
As our Senior Analytics Engineer for Operations, you'll own that data end to end, the model behind it, the metrics it produces, and the trust the business places in both.

This role isn't just "build the metric, ship the dashboard." We want someone who looks past the number to the process behind it, where it's manual, where it's fragile, where the right tool removes the work instead of just reporting on it. You'll have a direct line to influencing how those processes and the surrounding product actually work, not just how they're measured.

You'll sit embedded inside Operations, partnering with the TRI (Trust & Risk Intelligence) domain wherever the two overlap, while working inside the Data & Analytics team's AE guild — so you'll have the tools and the context to actually contribute, not just execute.

What You Will Be Doing

Own the Operations data model — reconciliation, treasury, payments, lifecycle, and onboarding — turning raw operational events into documented, trustworthy data products on the DWH
Partner directly with Operations stakeholders on day-to-day questions, ad hoc requests, and recurring reporting, acting as their primary data point of contact — while pushing routine, repeatable questions toward self-service instead of answering the same thing by hand every time
Look past the metric to the process behind it — understand how everything actually works end to end, spot where manual effort or fragile handoffs are the real problem, and identify which tools (not just which query) would solve it
Define and maintain key metrics for reconciliation accuracy, treasury positions, payment success/failure rates, and onboarding conversion, working within the team's central metric architecture
Participate in data quality and governance practices for the domain
Bring process and product ideas to the table directly — you're close enough to the operational reality to see what should change, and this role expects you to say so and help make it happen, not just report the numbers upward
Your First Six Months

First month Learn the Operations domain and how it currently works and reports, end to end. Meet your stakeholders and your teammates. Ship a first small, well-scoped fix or data product from the existing backlog to get real signal into the system quickly

First 3 months Own at least one Operations sub-domain's metrics end to end. Start contributing to the shared Risk/TRI conversations, and bring your first concrete process or tooling suggestion to a stakeholder — something you noticed while getting close to the actual workflow

First 6 months Operations stakeholders treat you as their data partner, not the new person. Routine checks are answered by self-service — what reaches you is what actually needs a person. You hold real, independent ownership over the data and workflows under your supervision

Who You Are


You've worked as an analytics engineer or senior analyst on technical projects involving data modeling on a modern data platform (Databricks, Spark, or dbt) — not just querying data others built
You write excellent SQL for analytical work, and you can pick up Python for anything SQL doesn't cover well
You're confident gathering requirements directly from operational stakeholders and turning ambiguous asks into clean, documented metrics
You default to precision over speed when the two are in tension — Operations data feeds regulatory and financial reporting, and being wrong quietly is worse than being slow
You can hold two stakeholders' definitions of "the same" metric and reconcile them, rather than picking whichever is more convenient
You think past the metric to the process it describes — you want to understand how the domain's tasks actually get done, spot which tool or automation would remove real work rather than just report on it, and you push for that change rather than waiting to be asked
You have a high level of autonomy and self-direction — you're the one who decides what needs fixing, not just how to measure it
AI-assisted workflows and tools are just part of how you work, not a novelty


Nice to Have


Background in banking, fintech, treasury, or payments operations
Experience working across multiple stakeholder groups with overlapping but not identical needs
Familiarity with regulatory or financial reporting data requirements

jobs.title: Client Success Coordinator - STEMAI
Principal Machine Learning Engineer GAIA
jobs.description:
Before the detail, here's the challenge you'd help us solve.

We build the embodied intelligence that moves real vehicles safely, and the ecosystem a billion machines will run on in the future. Very few people in AI can say this. Every role here, whatever the team, plugs into that.

Here’s what this particular role covers.

 

🛠️ About our Simulation Teams

You'll be joining the Simulation team (Simulation Evaluation & Validation), working on Gaia — Wayve's world model. Gaia is trained on large-scale driving video to predict future frames from past context, functioning as a simulator that generates synthetic scenarios and operates in closed loop with the driving model itself. The team partners closely with Research, Applications, Core Simulation Engineering, and Cloud/Infrastructure to turn model improvements into measurable downstream impact on the driving stack.

 

🧠 Your day-to-day

  • Own and lead parts of large-scale training for Gaia (language- or video-style training at scale), from experimentation through productionised training runs.

  • Contribute to and influence model architecture decisions — not just applying existing models.

  • Partner across sub-teams: Research (model development), Applications (adapting models to use cases), Core Simulation Engineering, and Cloud/Infrastructure.

  • Translate product and evaluation needs into model improvements (e.g. better long-horizon prediction, scenario generation quality, failure-case coverage).

  • Mentor and set technical direction, raising the engineering and research quality bar across the team.

 

🧩 What you’ll be working on

  • Leading and executing Gaia's post-training and closed-loop pipeline — fine-tuning and aligning the world model through post-training experimentation and targeted data curation.

  • Pushing Gaia's autoregressive generation towards longer, more stable rollouts, and making the model deployment-ready (inference time and reliability included).

  • Contributing to broader model architecture and training-strategy decisions where they intersect with pre- and post-training and the application layer.

  • Partnering closely with research, applications, simulation engineering, and cloud/infrastructure teams to translate post-training improvements into measurable downstream impact.

  • Providing technical leadership through mentorship, review, and setting high engineering/research standards.

 

🙌 You should apply if

Essential:

  • You have hands-on experience post-training/fine-tuning large-scale models (language, video, or other foundation models).

  • You have experience with world models, autoregressive generation, and long-horizon generation.

  • You have experience with diffusion/flow models and a solid understanding of 3D vision.

  • You have a strong understanding of model architecture and can contribute meaningfully to architectural/training decisions.

  • You have strong hands-on engineering skills with modern ML stacks (e.g. PyTorch), including debugging and performance/reliability-minded development.

  • You have 5+ years of relevant industry experience (advanced degrees are valued, but depth of applied experience matters more).

Desirable:

  • Experience with inference optimisation or deploying large models under latency/compute constraints.

  • Experience improving data/training pipelines and working across infrastructure constraints (distributed training, efficiency, reliability).

  • Proven technical leadership — tech lead ownership, mentoring, or setting direction across an area.

 

🌱 Not ticking every box? That’s totally okay! If you’re passionate about autonomy and keen to learn, we encourage you to apply even if you don’t meet every requirement.

 

More about Wayve:

🚀 Wayve is building the leading AI platform for autonomous driving. We are pioneering an end to end AI approach that enables vehicles to learn directly from real world experience, developing the ability to adapt, generalise and improve at scale. Instead of relying on hand coded rules or pre mapped environments, our AI Driver learns to drive by understanding the world around it. The result is technology that navigates complex urban environments with intelligence, precision and natural flow, unlocking meaningful advances in both safety and efficiency. We believe autonomy represents a once in a generation transformation in how people and goods move, comparable to the shift from horses to cars, and from human driven vehicles to intelligent machines.

Our ambition is to make autonomy universal. Wayve’s mapless and hardware agnostic AI platform integrates with global OEM partners, enabling continuous software evolution and unlocking advanced levels of automation from L2 plus through to L4 as our core AI model scales. In a race increasingly defined by intelligence and real world learning, Wayve is taking a distinct approach, building a generalisable driving intelligence that can power any vehicle, anywhere. By combining embodied AI with scalable deployment, we are creating technology that can be shaped to each OEM brand and driver experience, accelerating the transition to a safer, more intelligent future of mobility.

 

How we work 💻- Locations & Flexible Working:

Our main hubs are in London, Sunnyvale, Yokohama, Herzliya, Vancouver and Leonberg. We operate a hybrid working model that combines in-person collaboration in our dedicated office spaces with focused time working remotely. This gives our teams the connection and energy of working together, alongside the flexibility to do their best work in a way that fits their lives.

 

🔍 The Interview Process:

Our process is clear and respectful of your time:

  • Initial call / recruiter screen (30 mins)

  • Competency Interviews (Programming/Pytorch debugging and hiring manager interview; 2 hours total)

  • Deep-dive technical interviews (Systems & domain-specific interviews; 3 hours total)

  • Final interview: Mission & values alignment (45 mins).

We’ll always explain the format and work around your availability.

 

What’s in it for you (Location dependant):

💰 Salaries benchmarked against the market annually
📈 Meaningful equity, sharing in the ownership and long term success of Wayve
✈️ Relocation support and visa sponsorship where applicable
✅ Hybrid working, core hours and the chance to work hands on in vehicle workshops and labs
📚 Learning and development budgets with support for training, conferences and growth
🩺 Comprehensive benefits including health insurance, dental, enhanced maternity and paternity leave, retirement or pension where applicable, access to therapists, wellbeing partnerships, team socials and more

 

A quick, honest note before you apply.

Wayve is not a mature, fully-structured place with the playbook already written. Much of how we work is still being written, and if you join, you’ll help write it. That suits people who want real ownership more than people who need a settled structure from day one.

If that sounds like the kind of problem you want to spend your time on, we’d really like to hear from you.

At Wayve we're committed to creating a diverse, fair and respectful culture that is inclusive of everyone based on their unique skills and perspectives, and regardless of sex, race, religion or belief, ethnic or national origin, disability, age, citizenship, marital, domestic or civil partnership status, sexual orientation, gender identity, veteran status, pregnancy or related condition (including breastfeeding) or any other basis as protected by applicable law.

For more information visit Careers at Wayve. To learn more about what drives us, visit Values at Wayve

DISCLAIMER: We will not ask about marriage or pregnancy, care responsibilities or disabilities in any of our job adverts or interviews. However, we do look to capture information about care responsibilities, and disabilities among other diversity information as part of an optional DEI Monitoring form to help us identify areas of improvement in our hiring process and ensure that the process is inclusive and non-discriminatory.
